meta.title: Metrics journal
meta.description: One journal per project at .llm/metrics/ that records what the system can see in one record shape: every model call with its tokens and credits, every tool call and its outcome, turns, approvals, commands, the human's messages, and the events other rows hand in. Append-only and chained, so a dropped or edited line shows. The row checks yesterday and today in the background, and hands the loop board a daily self-check entry when it is there. Off by default.
